verdict.rationale: Orrick is a law firm offering legal services and self-service legal resources such as Tech Studio forms, document generators and health-check tools. An interactive developer API reference with runnable examples falls outside that product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Orrick publishes a public API or API documentation, so there is no shipped capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
